description: This file handles the display and logic for the related list view in the HelpDesk module of vtiger CRM, including entity retrieval, session management for related modules, and rendering the RelatedLists template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record and module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related list data for the current module and entity.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module, if any.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for the entity.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions or conditions for displaying buttons.
